message:
docs(tasks): the orphan is fixed, and what I wrote about it was wrong

Item 0.0.8 said the orphan does not arise on the normal path, that it was a rare
race, and that recording it was enough. All three were wrong. It happened twice on
2026-09-11 and each time it made the machine unusable: a Stream created a second
after the acknowledgement outlived its parent, kept UDP 43000 and 3478, and the
replacement host retried the bind to streak=36. Recovery took the user killing it
by hand.

Rewritten to say what was actually done (ecf340c) and what is still open, with the
grades kept honest: the four new checks are static wiring, not proof of the real
host's behaviour; the result: line theory is a possibility, not a finding; and the
0.2.114 client popup is unverified rather than working.

The remaining items are now listed separately instead of buried: the field re-test
with the entry point and the client left running, the three updater-lifetime
unknowns, and the unverified client popup.
